title: Jude and the Garden
author: Marguerite Crane
blurb: Quentin Joubert, a thief who steals memories, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
